description.ncbi_summary: The protein encoded by this gene is a secreted cytokine that induces cardiac myocyte hypertrophy in vitro. It has been shown to bind and activate the ILST/gp130 receoptor. Two transcript variants encoding different isoforms have been found for this gene. [provided by RefSeq, Dec 2008].

uniprot_function.text: Functions as a cytokine that binds to the LIF receptor complex (PubMed:8833032). The LIF receptor complex indeed consists of two signaling receptor subunits IL6ST/gp130 and LIFR that transduce the signal into the cell (By similarity). Functionally, acts as a potent cardiac survival factor, and promotes cardiomyocyte proliferation and hypertrophy (PubMed:8833032). Mechanistically, ligand binding to LIFR, induces heterodimerization with IL6ST/gp130 activating JAK tyrosine kinases (JAK1 or JAK2 and to a lesser extent TYK2) bound to their intracellular domains (By similarity). These kinases subsequently phosphorylate IL6ST/gp130 and LIFR (By similarity). The tyrosine phosphorylated signaling receptors serve in turn as docking sites for recruitment and activation of signal transducer and activator of transcription STAT3 (By similarity).
